Hi Team,
We have investigated the case reported by customer,
We could see the Charger is having active charging session.
Also, Following are the PLC Error Flags over period of 4Weeks,
As of now, Charger seems to be offline on SCB, We suggest plan a site intervention, And have spare door sensor.
Also, We need to check for the issue in the emergency line.
or Door Sensor is moving abnormally from it place or not pressing properly.
we need ensure the highlighted connections are tight and tidy as per schematics.
Do let me know if needed assistance in the site intervention.
